dimensions.name: Reasoning substrate (AX-01, AX-19)
families: LLM-direct: chain-of-thought legal conclusions emitted by a statistical model inside the trusted path
LLM-simulated-formal: model narrates formal reasoning; no solver ever executes (the 'scope laundering' pattern of arXiv 2606.16118)
credulous-argumentation: preferred/stable semantics with multiple extensions
recorded-unchecked-justification: rules and authorities recorded per conclusion but never machine-checked (AX-01 R2)
monotonic-classical-solver: FOL/SMT/Prolog with exceptions encoded ad hoc, machine-checked (absorbs: VeriCoT/L4L SMT adjudication substrate)

grounded-defeasible-certified: alternating-fixpoint well-founded/grounded labelling over a committed finite defeasible rulebase with offline-recheckable derivation certificates and certified defeater search (absorbs: ASPIC+/DDL/Turnip line, LLM-ASPIC+ with LLM as untrusted parser only, s(CASP) goal-directed justification trees, proof-carrying argument certificates candidate, defeater-coverage-certified compilation candidate, Carneades per-issue proof standards and burden allocation candidate)

prioritized-default-verified-calculus: Catala-class statute-shaped defaults+exceptions with verified compilation (absorbs: 'Closing the Loop' extended-Catala kernel, LogiKEy HOL embeddings as spec-level workbench)
precedential-constraint-CBR: Horty-style/hierarchical factor reasoning with decidable forced-decision checks (absorbs: hierarchical precedential constraint, case frames in statutory interpretation)

eliminations.lemma: Violates H1 (statistical model is the trusted legal reasoner) and H2 (guessing is structurally possible — fluent completion is the failure mode 700+ sanction cases document). Retained in D_T only inside the commercial-floor class K-COM as a dominance target.

Violates H1: the 'formal' step IS the model. arXiv 2606.16118 verifies scope laundering (solver-inconsistent conclusions reported without executing formal reasoning) persists across all tested models; only actual solver execution counts.

Violates H5: preferred/stable semantics yield non-unique extensions (NP-hard, answer depends on search order), so the trusted decision is not a pure function of frozen inputs. AX-01 ceiling derivation: grounded/well-founded is the unique semantics that is simultaneously deterministic, polynomial, and certificate-carrying.

Strictly dominated on AX-01: caps at R2 on the frozen ladder while grounded-defeasible-certified attains R5 (AX-01 ceiling attainment_mechanism, buildable on the existing JTMS seat) with no rank penalty on any other axis. Delta-rule gap ≥ 3 full ranks.

Strictly dominated on AX-01: without typed defeater objects the ladder caps it at R3 (R4 requires defeasibility as typed, searched objects), while grounded-defeasible-certified attains R5 at polynomial cost (alternating fixpoint) — no compensating advantage on any axis (grounded labelling is P-time vs NP for SMT, so not even AX-17 favors it). Representative classes K-RULES and K-NSV are RETAINED in D_T (K-NSV also in U_T) so the dominance is adjudicated by full 22-axis verdicts, not presumed.

dimensions.name: Grounding / corpus admission (AX-04)

enforced-typed-admission: sources enter only through typed, policy-checked admission; selection by exact committed identifier only; corpus-size-independent by construction

untrusted-candidate-retrieval: any statistical retrieval confined outside the trusted path, output re-entering only through admission (H1-conformant use of RAG)

eliminations.lemma: Violates H1 (neural encoder's ranking is the trusted grounding decision) and sits at AX-04 R1: grounding truth varies with corpus size, breaking the corpus-size-independence the AX-04 ceiling proves attainable. Survives only as untrusted-candidate-retrieval (H1 confinement).

Strictly dominated on AX-04: R2 vs R3+ where enforcement is structural (bypass impossible); the AX-04 ceiling attainment shows enforced typed admission is buildable today (primary-anchor.lisp dual-digest seat exists) at no cost on any other axis.

dimensions.name: Authority / citation validation (AX-05) — split from grounding: distinct frozen ladder
families: unvalidated-citation: citations emitted unchecked
LLM-judged-support: a model decides whether cited authority supports the proposition

grammar-total-proof-carrying-resolution: total coverage-gated recognizer over a declared decidable citation grammar L(G); every hit resolves through a verified receipt chain (owner-pinned signatures, delegation, revocation, bitemporal validity) to a per-citation offline-recheckable certificate; every non-L(G) citation-like string is typed UNKNOWN-CITATION that blocks (absorbs: citator-coupled formal reasoning candidate, Proof-Carrying Numbers claim-binding, VeriCite as untrusted candidate stage, authority-state/good-law-at-legal-time checking)

eliminations.lemma: Strictly dominated on AX-05: R1 while even the commercial floor ships R2-R3 mechanisms and the AX-05 ceiling proves R5 attainable over L(G) with existing B0 seats; ≥1 full-rank gap with zero compensating advantage anywhere.

Violates H1: support-checking verdict issued by a statistical model in the trusted path. The Ukrainian citation-graph result (17-33% false citations from leading systems, 59% of flags being verifier-coverage gaps) shows why the verdict must be a recomputable derivation, not model judgment.

Strictly dominated on AX-05: partial/sampled coverage scores one rank below the check's nominal rung by the frozen delta rule, and no offline certificate exists (H8: verdict rests on producer's database), capping at ~R3; grammar-total-proof-carrying-resolution attains R5 and SUBSUMES the citator DB as its authority-state component, so there is no compensating axis. Representative K-COM retained in D_T for adjudication.

foc04_checklist.u_t_nonempty_independent: U_T (the invariant-admissible region, candidates for E**) is nonempty with NINE members: K-B0 (design signature), K-SUP, K-ARG, K-CAT, K-CBR, K-NSV, K-RULES, K-TLOG, K-BFT. Independence from any winner holds by construction path: the 15 dimensions were derived from the 22 frozen axis ladders plus the six frontier sweep areas (every family string cites its ceiling rung or frontier finding), and classes were then formed as combinations of surviving families — not by describing B0 or any preferred design and generalizing outward. Positive evidence of independence: (a) several U_T members are built around mechanisms B0 does not contain and did not inspire — K-CAT's verified-calculus core (Catala/F*), K-CBR's precedential-constraint machinery, K-BFT's consensus substrate, K-NSV's per-output SMT/Lean verify-out; (b) U_T contains internal INCOMPARABLE pairs under the frozen non-compensatory order (K-CAT vs K-ARG: AX-21 transport vs AX-01 defeasibility scope; K-TLOG vs K-BFT: equivocation resistance vs AX-17/AX-18 class), each spawning a synthesis obligation per incomparable_rule S1 — a set clustered around one winner could not generate such pairs; (c) U_T deliberately contains K-RULES, a member expected to LOSE, so admissibility is demonstrably not a winner-selection filter. K-SUP is a function of the frozen ceilings' attainment_mechanisms (the per-dimension join), definable without examining any candidate, and under unknown_rule it currently carries typed UNKNOWNs on unimplemented axes, so it cannot be crowned — U_T is a genuine comparison set, not a coronation set.
foc04_checklist.d_t_not_winner_only: D_T is a 15-class quotient, of which at most one (K-SUP) is the presumptive target and at least six (K-COM, K-CRDT, K-AGT, K-TEE, K-GRAPH-as-shipped, K-HUM) are OUTSIDE the invariant-admissible region yet are retained as first-class comparison members — the precise handling the task demands: H1-H8 define OUR admissible region (who may be E**), while F_T is everything feasible in the world; the commercial class and B0 are members of D_T to be dominated with complete 22-axis verdict sets, never pruned. Structural guarantees that D_T ≠ {winner}: (1) grammar-level PER_DIMENSION_DOMINANCE eliminations remove families from E**-candidate signatures but every such elimination names its retained representative class in D_T (K-COM for five eliminated families, K-RULES, K-CRDT, K-AGT), so nothing eliminable vanishes before adjudication; (2) the retained non-admissible classes hold genuinely high rungs on specific axes (K-TEE near-ceiling on AX-13/AX-14; K-AGT high on AX-11/AX-15/AX-16; K-COM above R2 on AX-05/AX-07; K-HUM institutionally strong on AX-12) — so per-axis comparison against them is substantive, not ceremonial; (3) under the frozen termination_rule no winner can be declared here at all: K-B0 carries open H3/H8 residual obligations and K-SUP carries open UNKNOWNs, each of which counts as a surviving challenger under T1, and the two known INCOMPARABLE pairs carry undischarged synthesis obligations — this closure therefore delivers a domain and a front, expressly NOT a crowned candidate.
foc04_checklist.no_post_hoc: Nothing in this closure was reverse-engineered from a preferred design. (1) Order of construction: the 22 axis ladders, delta rules, verdict schema, unknown/incomparable/termination rules, and the 22 ceilings were frozen BEFORE this closure; every dimension family maps to a frozen ladder rung or to a dated, source-cited frontier finding (access dates 2026-08-28), and all ~60 missing_mechanism_candidates from the six sweep areas are absorbed into named families with the absorption recorded inline (verifiable by string inspection) — none was silently dropped, none spawned an ad-hoc dimension to flatter any candidate.
